guidelines.title: Prohibition of Guaranteed Returns and Assured Outcomes
guidelines.text: Never promise, state, or imply guaranteed financial returns, fixed interest profits, or risk-free investment outcomes. All financial growth and investment services are subject to market conditions and regulatory disclosures.

guidelines.title: Substantiation of Promotional and Superlative Claims
guidelines.text: Do not use superlatives such as 'best', 'No. 1', 'fastest', or 'cheapest' unless an exact, verified approved fact in the company fact base substantiates the claim. Comparative claims against named competitors are prohibited without legal approval.

guidelines.title: Professional and Reassuring Brand Tone
guidelines.text: Maintain a friendly, empathetic, but strictly professional tone across all channels. Never use flippant slang, sarcasm, or internet memes when discussing payment failures, technical glitches, or sensitive financial account actions.

guidelines.title: Plain Reading Level and Accessible Descriptions
guidelines.text: Headlines and marketing copy must be written at a clear, plain reading level (target grade 8 or below) without opaque jargon. Visual assets and campaign images must always include meaningful alternative text (alt text).

guidelines.title: Brand Name Accuracy and Official Nomenclature
guidelines.text: Always write the company brand name exactly as 'PayNest' with capital P and N. Never write 'Paynest', 'PN', or 'Pay Nest'. Always use approved glossary terms for core app capabilities.

guidelines.title: Typography and Clean Formatting
guidelines.text: Avoid deceptive formatting, excessive exclamation marks, and all-caps shouting (e.g. 'FREE MONEY NOW') in social media copy, subject lines, or digital advertising headlines.

glossary.note: Official brand name must always be written in CamelCase as PayNest.
